elaine: Quick company-wide note: we are deprecating the legacy SDK flag `compat_layer`. This will remove an old runtime path and let us enable new optimizations. Short timeline and resources below.
docs-bot: Migration doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk/remove-compat (codemod, linter, rollback runbook).
maria: Timeline?
elaine: Key dates: June 15 1 banner + docs email; July 15 1 enforcement for new orgs; Aug 1 1 canary (5% traffic); Sept 15 1 Hosted enforcement. Dedicated/Private on request.
kevin: Support & rollback?
support-bot: Office hours weekly starting June 18; #support-sdk-migrations created. Rollback via routing to `model_variant=v1-compat` or flip feature flag for canary.
docs-bot: Codemod: `rw-sdk-migrate --from compat_layer --to modern_api` and `rw-sdk-check` linter rule added. Run with --dry-run first.
elaine: Monitoring: we'll watch p50/p95, token error rate, and prompt diffs. Alerts if quality delta >= 3% or latency p50 regresses > 20ms.
maria: Marketing to prepare customer FAQ + email copy (due June 3). AMs to contact large Dedicated/private customers.
elaine: Action owners posted in the migration doc. Please run `rw-sdk-check` on your repos and tag tickets `sdk-compat-migration`. Thanks!
